ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.hypothesis: The selected fragment path fails to export intended primary color
ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.confirmed_facts: Four virtual primary-color MOVs were eliminated in the retained compiler trace. Compiled attribute count is 0; linked fragment contains only 00000000 f8040140; middle launch word is 00030000. Actual module contains those exact bytes.
ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.unproved: Suffix instruction semantics, implicit color forwarding and actual hardware fragment export. It is NOT established that the suffix is a no-op or that no fragment color write can occur.
ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.minimum_distinguishing_fact: SGX535-applicable semantics of this linked program and its attribute/output mapping, or an attributable fragment-output observation.

ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.hypothesis: TA/state upload/ISP produces no surviving triangle coverage
ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.confirmed_facts: The 68-byte stream, 96-byte vertices, index packet, 11/14/2-word state uploads, widths and references match the retained CPU encoders. Completions do not report primitive/fragment coverage.
ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.unproved: Actual produced region/primitive data and coverage; no such checkpoint is in FIRE #2.
ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.minimum_distinguishing_fact: Attributable post-TA pre-raster scene/region coverage, interpreted under a validated format. Raw changed scene bytes alone do not prove a triangle.

ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.hypothesis: Target/event/PBE path writes zero, writes elsewhere, or leaves data invisible to CPU
ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.confirmed_facts: Both target and background descriptors address the same color BO; full 4096 bytes, stride128; event launch points at the emitted event PDS. Target/raster literals match references; host flush/readback uses the same owned page.
ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.unproved: Actual PBE store/address/value and device cache visibility. Completion bits do not include these data.
ranked_hypotheses_by_specific_existing_e.minimum_distinguishing_fact: Attributable color-store destination/value or independently established PBE write/visibility postcondition; a host-only cache flush is not a hardware proof.

excluded_explanations: A row flip or channel/tiling permutation alone cannot turn every zero byte into intended opaque white.
Short/truncated image or incorrect response/capsule copy is contradicted by the sealed 4096-byte agreement.
Mistyped primitive record or demonstrable host relocation drift was not found; changing those fields is unjustified.

next_discriminating_observation.boundary: After accepted TA_FINISHED, before ISP reset/raster scheduling and before DPM retirement/free destroys produced scene evidence
next_discriminating_observation.required_fact: Whether T produced relevant triangle region/primitive coverage. Retain that fact from the current owner; preserve published inputs/address bindings alongside it.
next_discriminating_observation.limitations: Requires a validated scene-output interpretation; raw nonzero bytes are insufficient. If coverage is present, resolve the fragment-export/PBE branch next. No completion clearing, reset, submission or client invocation is authorized by this analysis.

live_qualification: Justified only after a concrete fix or qualified discriminating observation candidate; unchanged blind retry is not justified
additional_reference_crosscheck: Retained helper ELF2648d–26493 also emits 00000000/f8040140 for an 8-byte helper allocation. This establishes repeated CPU emission, not NOP semantics or absence of implicit pixel output.
